# Hey AI, Help!

> Done for you AI services and hands on AI workshops for small businesses.
> Based in Salem, Oregon, serving all of Oregon and clients outside Oregon.
> Founded by Denise, who is Claude certified. Monthly service from $549.
> Workshops from $199 per person.

## What we do
- Claude, Working for You: a monthly service. Hey AI, Help! runs AI on the
  client's behalf and delivers finished work. Business documents, process
  documents, communication templates, one off drafting, Google Business
  Profile posts, review requests, social media, search result updates,
  websites and apps.
- Workshops: Beginner, Intermediate: Operations, and Intermediate: Marketing.
  Full day, up to 20 people, $199 per person.
- Private group workshop: up to 15 people, customized, $2,000 flat.
- Hourly support: one on one help, remote or in person, $125 per hour.

## Monthly pricing
- Growth: $549 per month, about 7 to 8 hours of work each month
- Full Ops: $899 per month, about 14 to 15 hours of work each month
- Additional hours: $60 per hour

## Who we help
Small business owners, trades and contractors, and the professionals who
keep small businesses running. Construction paperwork includes bids,
proposals, prevailing wage documentation, and checking contract
deliverables against project design specs. For medical and healthcare
offices, administrative paperwork only, never clinical records.

## About the founder
Denise spent 20 years in Oregon state government, where she assisted the
commissioner of the Oregon Bureau of Labor and Industries with setting
state prevailing wage rates. She later ran a medical clinic. She is
Claude certified.

## Where we work
Based in Salem, Oregon. Serves all of Oregon, in person or remotely, and
works with clients outside Oregon too.

## Hours
Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm Pacific.
